content: {"phoneNote":"Hero card and the contact section both end up repeating address, hours and directions; the second gallery image bleeds past its container and the hero photo is cut to green leaves with the house lost.","desktopNote":"Hero card clips its two action links at the bottom of the viewport and the group-booking section leaves a wide dead right half; contact block and footer repeat the same address and hours.","phone":{"impression":3,"hierarchy":4,"imagery":3,"spacing":3,"clutter":2,"distinctiveness":4},"desktop":{"impression":3,"hierarchy":3,"imagery":4,"spacing":2,"clutter":2,"distinctiveness":4},"fixes":["Merge the 'Pokličite za rezervacijo' contact block and the footer 'Obiščite nas'/'Delovni čas' into one contact section so address, hours and directions appear once.","Shorten the desktop hero (or lift the card) so both action links sit well inside the first screen, and crop the phone hero to show the house and lime tree, not only foliage.","Fill the empty right half of the 'Sprejemamo rezervacije za skupine' section (desktop) with the dining-room photo and tuck the small overflow image back into the gallery grid."],"blockers":["Desktop hero: the 'Rezervirajte mizo' and 'Poglejte ponudbo' links are clipped at the bottom edge of the first screen.","Phone and desktop: the dining-room photo overflows the gallery and runs into the next section's divider.","Phone and desktop: address, directions link and opening hours are repeated in the contact section and again in the footer.","Desktop 'Sprejemamo rezervacije' section: layout leaves a large empty band on the right with only a lone link."]}
